question: Does the DENR FMB Redelineated Watersheds Feb2025 polygon layer provide validated boundaries for the DA/CvSU-reported Labac-Alemang and Caisobo units?

source.title: Redelineated Watersheds Feb2025 (CWS_Merge_2425_WGS)
source.provider: Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Forest Management Bureau (FMB)
source.description: Blank in reviewed REST service and layer metadata.
source.copyrightText: Blank in reviewed REST service and layer metadata.

access.method: Reviewed the official DENR FMB REST directory, service metadata, and polygon layer fields; queried exact w_name values with returnGeometry=true in the native spatial reference.

query.where: w_name IN ('Caisobo River Watershed','Labac-Alemang River Watershed')

features.sourceMatch: The name matches the current DA 2022 watershed-name field but the polygon area is far below the DA row’s 9,917 ha aggregate; unit equivalence is not established.
The name matches the DA/RPFP and CvSU study label, but the polygon area is below the CvSU 2019 study-area value of 9,086 ha; unit equivalence is not established.

findings.layerEvidence: The official service marks layer 0 as a polygon feature layer in EPSG:32651, with fields including w_name, region, area_ha, nis and nia_moa, and supports Query.
findings.returnedGeometry: Exact-name queries returned one polygon for each label. Calculated ring areas match area_ha to rounding; this is an arithmetic check, not validation of boundary meaning or lineage.
findings.scopeConflict: DA 2022 describes a 9,917 ha aggregate management unit named Caisobo with Labac-Alemang and Caisobo listed as subwatersheds; the 2019 CvSU Labac-Alemang study reports 9,086 ha. The FMB layer returns 1,819.151 ha and 4,046.107 ha for the exact-name polygons. These different areas could represent different delineation units, but the layer supplies no crosswalk to resolve them.
findings.irrigationAttributes: The feature attributes associate Caisobo with Culong-Culong RIS and Labac-Alemang with Sahing RIS. This makes irrigation-catchment scope a plausible interpretation, not a confirmed layer definition.
findings.sourceLineage: The layer/service names contain Feb2025, but no precise creation or delineation date, method, input data, positional accuracy, or boundary-version lineage was found in reviewed metadata.
findings.reuse: The REST metadata has blank Description and Copyright Text fields; no item-specific open license or reuse permission was found. Queryability alone does not grant redistribution rights.

nextAction: Request or locate the FMB layer’s full metadata, method/version and reuse terms, then compare its polygons with the official DA/CvSU delineation units. Keep these queryable polygons out of public map layers and do not conflate them with Labac River channel geometry or fish evidence.
